Hey team,

Quick recap from this morning: Acorn Analytics is evaluating a replacement for their current SDR cadence tool and wants an RFP-style response by next Tuesday (Sept 8). They explicitly asked for: feature parity vs. their current provider, estimated migration effort, CRM connector pricing (bulk sync vs. per-user), and SOC2/attestation details.

Actions I think we should take this week:
- Sean: can you pull current standard discounts for FY27 and draft a preliminary budget impact (delta to baseline)?
- Rafael: could you own pricing scenarios and a short migration plan (technical effort + timeline)?
- Mina: need product to confirm the custom CRM connector feasibility — is the connector part of Redwood Optimize or an add-on?

I attached the meeting notes (stub). I'll coordinate with procurement but want to ensure we present one clear price + a migration credit option.

Preliminary numbers (very high level):
- Standard per-seat list price: $45/user/month
- Typical enterprise band (250-500 seats): 18-25% off list + 6-12 month payment commit
- CRM connector (managed sync) is typically a separate add-on: $12k/year for org-wide; $2/user/month if per-seat

Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 10:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Acorn RFP: SDR cadence platform - initial clarifications

Hi Jenna — thanks for the RFP. A few clarifying points so we can scope the migration and provide accurate pricing: 

1) Sandbox for demos: yes — we can provision a time-limited sandbox with an anonymized sample dataset. We typically need 5 business days to onboard a sandbox and validate connectors.
2) Data retention: default retention is 365 days but retention windows can be configured per workspace (policy-managed). We can also offer extended retention as an add-on.
3) SOC2/pen test: we can provide our SOC2 Type II report and a redacted pen-test summary in the compliance appendix.
4) CRM connector: two models available — "Managed Sync" (org-level, $12k/year — includes delta handling and support) and "Self-Serve Connector" ($2/user/month). We can also quote a blended price for your seat count if you prefer a single line item.

Migration estimate (baseline):
- Data mapping + 2x migration runs: 5-7 days of engineering + 8-12 hours of PM coordination.
- One-off professional services estimate: $9,500 (includes field mapping, test migration, and cutover support).

Would you like us to show a version with a migration credit (1 month) and a 12-month committed discount? If so, I will produce a pricing appendix and draft SOW.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Laura/Mina —

Summary: Acorn is a mid-market customer (~380 SDR seats). They’re evaluating three vendors; procurement wants an RFP response by Sept 8. Rafael has proposed pricing scenarios and a modest PS line for migration. Sean’s cost sketch suggests we can fit this into FY27 bookings with a 20% blended discount and a migration credit without degrading unit economics.

Recommendation (short):
- Submit standard RFP response with: org-wide managed connector option + per-seat alternative, sandbox offer, SOC2 materials, and a 1-month migration credit tied to a 12-month committed contract.
- Offer professional services SOW at $9.5k and a discounted bundled price of $7k if they sign within 14 days of the finalist demo.
- Sales ops — please bake the blended quote into the HubSpot deal (link below) and tag as "FY27-RFP".

Attached: pricing_appendix_ACRN.csv (draft). Rafael — please finalize the pricing appendix and SOW by EOD Friday so I can review before we send to Jenna.

Marissa
